test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**has been**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence talks about an ongoing perception or recognition of the couple's public life as an inspiration.
 
• The correct tense for an action or state that started in the past and is still true or relevant is the **present perfect**, formed as "**has/have been**".
 
• "**Has been**" fits with the singular subject "Their very public love story and family life".
 
• Incorrect options: 
 
 
• **Is been** – Grammatically incorrect; "is" and "been" do not go together without "being".
 
• **Was being** – Past continuous passive; incorrect here as the statement is general and present in nature.
 
• **Will been** – Incorrect tense form; "will have been" would be the correct future perfect form, but that doesn’t fit the context.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Sentence: *Their very public love story and family life – they have two children – **has been**__ seen as an inspiration for their supporters.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Is been** – ❌ Not a valid verb form in any tense.
 
• **Was being** – ❌ Used for temporary past states or actions in progress, not fitting the meaning here.
 
• **Will been** – ❌ Invalid; the future perfect form is “will have been.”
